channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Oshae Brissett | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Oshae Brissett from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Oshae Brissett
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on Oshae Brissett signing a 10-day contract with the 76ers:

“That’s my brother. Happy for him. He definitely deserves to be in the league so hopefully he finds a home – even if it’s in Philadelphia.”

Jayson Tatum on Oshae Brissett, Mar 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Oshae Brissett
item.description:
Noa Dalzell:Joe Mazzulla on Oshae Brissett:

“He’s one of my favorite guys I’ve ever coached— the personality, his character, who he is. Great teammate. It was great to be able to see him, spend time with him. I just hope it works out for him.”

Joe Mazzulla on Oshae Brissett, Nov 22, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Oshae Brissett
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Oshae Brissett:

“He plays with such a high level of intensity and energy, it's big for us.”

Joe Mazzulla on Oshae Brissett, May 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.
